subject: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell incentive renewal — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@amazon.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing fee structure — draft term sheet

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the productive conversation last week. Attached is the draft term sheet for the AWS Marketplace listing (see 20270518-proposed-fee-schedule.pdf). Key callouts: 12% listing commission, 6% co-sell incentive for referrals within the first 12 months, and a 60-day promotional credit of $50k for new dedicated accounts.

We can consider a modest increase to the co-sell incentive if Redwood commits to a larger quarterly minimum for Dedicated instances (we discussed a 20% uplift to the baseline commit). I flagged Jacob from our channel team in case we need to loop a channel partner into the technical/GT discussions.

Let me know if we should book time with procurement/legal to move to an LOA.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Marketplace Partner Manager — AWS
Attachments: 20270518-proposed-fee-schedule.pdf
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@amazon.com>, Jacob Reeves <jacob.reeves@cloudbroker.example.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fee structure — draft term sheet

Lena — thanks for sending this over. Quick summary of Redwood's position:

- We appreciate the promotional credit and the initial co-sell incentive.
- 12% listing commission is higher than comparable listings we've negotiated (we typically land in the 7–10% band for committed-volume listings).
- We can commit to the quarterly minimum, but need flexibility on the first-year ramp (we expect usage growth to be stepwise).

Ask: can AWS drop the listing commission to 9% conditional on a two-year commit with a mid-year performance review? In exchange we can accept a 6.5% co-sell incentive, but request a guaranteed additional $75k of listing credits tied to outreach milestones (e.g., joint webinars / co-marketing) over the first 12 months.

I'm attaching Redwood's proposed counter (redwood_aws_co-sell_term_sheet_v3.docx) that maps to those asks. We're trying to get procurement/legal aligned this month so we can include this in Q3 budgeting.

If this is acceptable in principle, let's schedule a 30-minute call with procurement/legal next week.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Attachments: redwood_aws_co-sell_term_sheet_v3.docx
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace listing fee structure — draft term sheet

Folks — forwarding Lena's draft and the counter I sent. Highlights for finance/legal review:

- Current AWS ask: 12% listing commission, 6% co-sell.
- Our counter: 9% listing on a 2-year commit; 6.5% co-sell; $75k additional listing credits tied to marketing milestones.

Laura — can you run quick math on net per-token economics if we assume 30% of hosted revenue flows through Marketplace vs direct API? Also any procurement timing constraints we should track?

Karthik — if we accept the 2-year commit, do we need a separate SOW for Dedicated capacity guarantees (or will the Marketplace LOA suffice)?

I added a short checklist at the bottom for what I want before the call with Lena:
- Finance: delta to unit economics and renewal cadence impact
- Legal: sample LOA redlines we typically push back on (termination for convenience, audit rights, data ownership)
- Partnerships: run co-marketing milestone list and agree on KPIs for the $75k credits

Thanks,
S

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 10:12 AM Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@amazon.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@amazon.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Jacob Reeves <jacob.reeves@cloudbroker.example.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fee structure — draft term sheet

Stephanie — appreciate the clear asks and the draft you sent. I discussed internally and can offer the following as a middle path:

- Listing commission: 10% (final) if Redwood signs a 24-month LOA with a minimum quarterly commit at 20% above the baseline we discussed.
- Co-sell incentive: 6.5% for the first 12 months, stepping down to 5% in year two unless renewal KPIs are met.
- Additional listing credits: $75k in marketing co-funding paid as milestones (50% after first joint webinar, 50% after first 3 joint customer references).
- Promotional credit: extend the $50k promo to 90 days instead of 60.

We can get procurement involved to turn the terms into an LOA. Two notes: channel partner involvement (Jacob) can help with go-to-market motion, but the commit level must be firm to justify the 10% concession.

If you can confirm acceptance of the 10% / 6.5% / $75k structure, I will ask legal/procurement to draft LOA and loop you for redlines.

Best,
Lena
Attachments: none
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@amazon.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Jacob Reeves <jacob.reeves@cloudbroker.example.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fee structure — draft term sheet

Lena — thank you, that structure is acceptable in principle. We agree to: 10% listing commission on a 24-month LOA with the quarterly commit at +20% baseline; 6.5% co-sell year 1 (5% year 2 fallback); $75k co-marketing credits tied to milestones; 90-day promotional credit.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll confirm the exact quarterly commit numbers with Finance (Laura) by EOD Tuesday and pull together the co-marketing milestones.
- Karthik will flag any SOW/technical gating items needed for Dedicated capacity.
- Once we send the acceptance note, please have procurement/legal produce the LOA/DocuSign link so we can circulate for signatures.

If procurement needs anything else from our side (financials, exec approval memo), Laura will provide. Looking to close LOA before the end of June to align with Q3 planning.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20270527-aws-term-sheet-revA.pdf
